evals.prompt: Product says only a team member may export a report. Add this to our one-page spec. We already have an export schema.
evals.expected_output: Updates the owning section in index.md, cites the approved policy and existing schema, and adds stable acceptance rows for allowed and denied behavior with observable data effects and verification. Escalates undefined behavior to the owner.

evals.prompt: The audit found that the retry after a partial charge is unspecified. Repair the spec; nobody has decided whether a second authorization is permitted.
evals.expected_output: Records the blocked branch and the decision needed beside the rule. Describes the side effect and recovery proof the decision affects. Continues independent work without inventing a retry.

evals.prompt: Our customer-visible export explanation has a typo. Correct the wording while keeping all linked behavior and the reviewed diagram accurate.
evals.expected_output: Edits the governing section and checks dependents, anchors and diagram fidelity. Reports scoped reapproval if a bound section changed. Preserves unrelated approvals and tickets.

evals.prompt: Turn the product meeting into a discoverable record. Finance approved one option and proposed a second; notes contain internal customer information.
evals.expected_output: Keeps raw meeting records private, records the approved decision with its authority and affected rule, and distinguishes the proposal and any blocking question. Links relevant records from the owning topic.

evals.prompt: Here is an approved service schema. The server and client have invented slightly different DTOs and the UI hides forbidden fields. Define the boundary and safe release outcome.
evals.expected_output: Inspects current consumers, reuses the authoritative schema and defines projection, loss/redaction, contract-native validation, consumer proof and rollback. Describes which actor observes which final state.

evals.prompt: Can we start planning from these existing specs? Confirm approval without changing any requirements.
evals.expected_output: Routes to spec-readiness-review for digest-bound evidence and the approved check.

evals.prompt: We only have a rough problem statement. Support wants a faster intake process, and the approval route is still up for discussion. Start the project spec.
evals.expected_output: Creates a discoverable one-page draft with intent and the open approval question. Adds no required frontmatter or acceptance rows for undefined behavior.
